**Mineola, NY – October 28, 2026** – Hanover Bancorp, Inc. (“Hanover” or “the Company” – NASDAQ: HNVR), the holding company for Hanover Community Bank (“the Bank”), today reported results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 and the declaration of a $0.10 per share cash dividend on both common shares and Series A preferred shares payable on November 18, 2026 to stockholders of record on November 11, 2026.


“Our third quarter performance demonstrates the powerful momentum across our franchise, highlighted by record net interest income and our highest pre-provision net revenue since 2022. Driven by strong loan growth, net income rose to $4.3 million, or $0.60 per diluted share, for the third quarter of 2026. Our balance sheet eclipsed $2.4 billion in total assets this quarter, fueled by the deepening of our niche-residential lending and CRE and C&I banking relationships, which propelled demand deposits to a record $255.1 million and loan production to $178.7 million.


“We remain highly committed to delivering robust shareholder returns, as reflected in our improved returns on average assets and tangible equity, our ongoing share repurchase program, and the declaration of our $0.10 per share quarterly cash dividend. Looking ahead, we are incredibly excited about our new full-service Riverhead branch, which opened on September 30th. This expansion marks a pivotal step in bringing our comprehensive suite of banking services closer to our clients on the East End of Long Island, positioning us well for continued, disciplined growth.”


#### Michael P. Puorro,
Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Hanover Bank
